name: Corridor Raycaster
promptTemplate: A demoscene pseudo-3D raycaster wandering a procedural maze rendered with {{theme}} styling at {{render_res}} resolution, cruising at speed {{move_speed}} with a {{fov}} degree field of view and depth fog set to {{fog_depth}}.

theme.hint: Swaps wall tints and floor grid palettes

render_res.hint: Ray strip granularity on the wall

fov.hint: Lens width from tight corridor to fish-eye

fog_depth.hint: Adjust corridor depth fade into shadow

listing.blurb: A raycaster fly-through of a procedural maze in the manner of early first-person games: flat-shaded walls darkening with distance, a floor gradient, the camera walking the corridors on its own.
listing.prompt: A raycaster fly-through of a procedural maze in the manner of early first-person games: flat-shaded walls darkening with distance, a floor gradient, the camera walking the corridors on its own. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
